summary: Apache Airflow: RCE by race condition in example_xcom dag
facts: The documented example_xcom pattern read attacker-modifiable XCom values in a way that could lead to code execution on a worker.
The issue affects copied example code rather than the Airflow release itself; Airflow 3.2.0 documentation uses a more resilient pattern.

provenance.source: GitHub Advisory API and officially referenced PR head

summary: mlflow Creates of Temporary File in Directory with Insecure Permissions
facts: MLflow created Python virtual-environment temporary directories with world-writable permissions.
A local attacker able to write under /tmp could race and overwrite Python files, leading to code execution.

summary: NVIDIA NeMo Framework contains a vulnerability leading to Remote Code Execution
facts: A malicious input can trigger unsafe deserialization and remote code execution in NVIDIA NeMo Framework.
A successful exploit may also cause privilege escalation, information disclosure and data tampering.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: no authoritative source commit in the advisory

summary: OpenClaw has an arbitrary transcript path file write via gateway sessionFile
facts: An authenticated gateway client could supply sessionFile outside the sessions directory and cause transcript creation or append at an arbitrary host path.
The issue does not by itself establish remote code execution.
The fix constrains transcript paths to the sessions directory with resolveSessionFilePath containment checks.

summary: Paperclip: Unauthenticated Access to Multiple API Endpoints in Authenticated Mode
facts: Several Paperclip API endpoints omitted authentication in authenticated deployment mode.
Unauthenticated callers could read heartbeat issue data, create CLI authentication challenges, inspect agent instructions and retrieve deployment details.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: no authoritative source commit in the advisory

summary: Flowise doesn't Prevent Bypass of Password Confirmation through Unverified Email Change (credentials)
facts: The account email used for login or recovery could be changed without confirmation to the old email or another authority check.
An attacker with an authenticated session could redirect recovery to an attacker-controlled address and take over the account.

provenance.source: GitHub Advisory API and officially referenced PR head

summary: Langflow Missing Authentication on Critical API Endpoints
facts: Three monitor API endpoints omitted the get_current_active_user dependency.
Unauthenticated callers could access messages and transactions or delete messages by session.

summary: Self-hosted n8n has Legacy Code node that enables arbitrary file read/write
facts: Authenticated workflow editors on self-hosted n8n using legacy JavaScript Code-node execution could invoke internal helpers.
Those helpers could read and write host files with the n8n process privileges, subject to configured filesystem restrictions.
n8n 2.0.0 enables task runners by default; older supported versions can enable them with N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED=true.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: configuration and default-execution-mode remediation; no atomic fix commit in the advisory

summary: Open WebUI vulnerable to Stored DOM XSS via prompts when 'Insert Prompt as Rich Text' is enabled resulting in ATO/RCE
facts: Prompt text parsed as rich text was assigned to tempDiv.innerHTML without meaningful sanitization.
A user permitted to create prompts could plant JavaScript triggered when another user inserted that prompt; an administrator victim could be induced to perform privileged backend actions.

summary: WeKnora Vulnerable to Broken Access Control in Tenant Management
facts: Tenant handlers accepted a path tenant ID and called the service layer without verifying tenant ownership or cross-tenant privileges.
Authenticated users could read, modify or delete other tenants; open registration made the path reachable to an external attacker after account creation.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: no authoritative source commit in the advisory

summary: OpenClaw: Sandbox escape via TOCTOU race in remote FS bridge readFile
facts: Remote sandbox reads checked a canonical path and later performed a separate file read, leaving a time-of-check/time-of-use race.
An attacker could replace a path component after validation so cat read outside the allowed mount.

summary: n8n has In-Process Memory Disclosure in its Task Runner
facts: An authenticated workflow editor could use the JavaScript Task Runner to allocate uninitialized native buffers.
Residual process memory could disclose prior request data, task data, secrets or tokens.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: the advisory publishes patched versions but no atomic source commit

summary: Flowise has Authentication Bypass Using Unprotected Registration Endpoint (/register)
facts: The /api/v1/account/register endpoint was reachable without authentication in Enterprise mode.
A caller could create an active owner account without a valid invitation or an existing-owner check.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: the advisory does not identify an atomic source fix
